definitions.explanation: Refusing to change one's mind or yield to others' opinions, even when it would be reasonable to do so. Carries a negative connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強情|ごうじょう}で⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かない→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: He's stubborn and won't listen to others.

examples.japanese: {強情|ごうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}らないで→張る：12583_haru⟧、⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{謝|あやま}り→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Stop being stubborn and apologize honestly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{強情|ごうじょう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{決|き}めたら→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}げない→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has always been headstrong — once he decides something, he never backs down.

notes:
USAGE:
Negative nuance — describes someone who unreasonably refuses to compromise. The set phrase {強情|ごうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to insist stubbornly) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強情|ごうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to be obstinate; to dig in one's heels)
- {強情|ごうじょう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a stubborn person)
- {強情|ごうじょう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a stubborn personality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧: stubborn; obstinate — similar but can be used more neutrally or even positively (principled)
- ⟦{意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}り→意地っ張り：18869_ijippari⟧: willful; obstinate — more colloquial, often used about children
